data.name: Bilalun
data.gender_notes: Bilalun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Bilal ibn Rabah was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the first muezzin. The name Bilal is derived from the Arabic word bilal, meaning 'owner' or 'master'. The suffix 'un' signifies 'friend' or 'companion'. Thus, Bilalun means 'Owner and Companion'. The name Bilalun carries the meaning “Owner/Companion of the mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bilalun usually hope their child will grow to embody owner/companion of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strong faith and dedication to one's religion.
data.etymology: Bilalun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Owner/Companion of the mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilalun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This crucial role played by Bilal in spreading the call of Allah showcases the level of companionship, devotion, and commitment among early Muslims. The name Bilalun celebrates this history and the legacy of early Muslims who devoted their lives to serving their community and upholding the Islamic faith. The name is a reminder of their unwavering dedication towards Allah and their significant contributions to Islamic traditions.

Bilal, as the 'owner', embodies the idea of submitting oneself to Allah as a devoted servant or slave. The 'companion' aspect highlights the importance of having Allah as one's best friend and constant companion. The name inspires individuals to strive towards achieving this bond and closeness with Allah, and to always remember that their ultimate Master and Friend is Allah himself.
